north_star: Aiko is a system of authenticated, stateless interface projections over one Contract organism: verified transports project stimuli into existing W6H/CausalEvent occurrences; Contract owns root lineage, scoped cited context, readiness, invalidation and fenced semantic settlement; Smithers owns only cross-pinned operational scheduling; Cell is the pinned harness; Neuron owns admitted capabilities, effects, read-back, redrive and compensation; recursively spawned Aikos are capability-bounded descendants, never ambient-authority peers or unrestricted shared memory.

children.what: Specify projection and authority without new ledgers. Define VerifiedIngress emitted only by each transport auth boundary: authenticated subject, tenant, transport/audience, granted scopes, canonical request digest, nonce/idempotency namespace and verification evidence. HookEventEnvelope tenant/role/root/account/effect fields are untrusted hints. Define a non-conflated identity matrix (principal, tenant, Contract root/parent/occurrence, execution/run/session, lease fence, firing, logical effect and credential generation); canonical occurrence identity hashes the verified namespace/key/root tuple while separately pinning payload digest. Same tuple+digest is replay; changed bytes/subject/scope is conflict. Classify hooks: Contract declaration, authority and effects are ordered synchronous fail-closed choke points; only observational hooks may fail open. Fix order normalize/confine → authenticate → declare/adopt → scope/authorize → lease → invoke → read-back/evidence → settle/invalidate. Context is a Contract read projection; timestamps/transcripts never enter identity or authority. Webhook identity binds endpoint generation, verified tenant/principal, provider namespace, delivery id and raw-body digest; a repeated delivery with changed bytes conflicts. Endpoint creation/deployment is an authorized Contract occurrence, never prompt-granted ambient infrastructure authority.
children.falsifier: Introduce HookOccurrence/ContextEnvelope storage; authorize caller-supplied tenant/role/lineage; coalesce the same key across tenant/interface/digest; use timestamps as identity; or let a failed mandatory projection launch anything. Accept reserialized-body signatures, cross-endpoint replay, caller-chosen endpoint IDs, or prompt-only Cloudflare deployment authority.

children.what: Create the process-spawn authority membrane used by Smithers Aiko agents: inheritEnv=false, explicit minimal env allowlist, canonical cwd confinement, yolo=false/non-bypass permission mode, exact account/provider generation, no quota/auth fallback, and redacted argv/env diagnostics. Capture and test the actual child process rather than constructor intent. Run the witness through the aiko-flow native package root; repository-root Bun path resolution is not the project runtime.
children.falsifier: Seed ambient API keys, HOME credentials, alternate accounts and malicious cwd symlinks; any child receipt, fallback, bypassPermissions or path escape makes the gate red.

children.what: Separate arbitrary command/HTTP hooks from mandatory Contract projection. Default-deny and schema-minimize hook inputs; transcript paths, prompts, raw tool inputs/results, credentials, full env and sibling-tenant paths require explicit per-field capability. Sandbox command hooks, confine paths/symlinks, constrain HTTP destinations/egress, and redact HookRunResult/logs. Preserve generic fail-open only for non-authoritative observers.
children.witness: cd aiko && cargo test -p xai-grok-hooks data_membrane -- --nocapture
children.falsifier: A malicious trusted project/plugin hook exfiltrates canary env, transcript, raw payload or sibling files through stdin, HTTP, logs or results; or a symlink escapes workspace confinement. Merely compile path-included membrane modules while production command/http runners still serialize the full envelope or inherit ambient env; the gate must inspect and exercise the real runner path.

children.what: Implement context as a deterministic, versioned read model over existing Contract rows, graph input_bindings, settlements, archives and Neuron evidence citations. Filters consume VerifiedIngress/delegation capability, never payload claims. Visibility is purpose/audience and field scoped: explicitly delegated cited inputs only; exclude sibling-private rows, transcripts/prompts, raw tool payloads, credentials, stale/revoked/invalidated facts. Preserve resolvable citation digests/ordinals through session compaction without a durable context cache or database; source movement invalidates the projection.

If build.zig does not compile/run context_projection.zig, the exact witness is not evidence and must fail.

children.what: Move opaque account capabilities into native Aiko auth. Bind every handle to verified subject, tenant, Contract execution+lease fence, destination audience/host, operation/resource, generation, expiry/MFA/revoke and replay policy. Resolve account credentials—not API-key payloads—only after the admitted destination (including redirects) is fixed, and revalidate immediately before use. Contract/Smithers/Cell/Neuron retain only handle metadata and evidence; secret bytes never enter argv/env/stdin/prompt/tmp/logs.

children.what: Make Contract execution fencing authoritative. Every grant returns a unique lease_id/fence and owner incarnation under Contract time; renew/settle are CAS over execution, attempt, fence, graph/input version and current nonterminal control state. Expired/superseded workers cannot invoke or settle even with the same owner label. Define commit ordinal ordering, stale-invalidation refusal, hierarchical pause/cancel/deadline semantics, effect-key serialization and bounded claim batches. Cancellation stops claims, fences late settlement and distinguishes cancelled, timed_out_retryable and terminal died; crossed work becomes compensation.
children.falsifier: Two workers reuse owner label; clocks jump; lease expires/reassigns; invalidation/revoke/cancel races settlement; old worker must fail every mutation and crossed work must not replay.

children.what: Route CLI/headless/ACP/MCP/plugin/Gateway/webhook/cron through one built-in fail-closed Contract ingress before any agent, workflow, tool or effect. Each adapter verifies its native auth, emits VerifiedIngress, canonicalizes workspace paths, then projects into existing declare-turn-context/W6H/CausalEvent operations. Missing/slow/crashed/malformed ABI or projection means no launch. Duplicate concurrent delivery adopts only an identical occurrence+payload digest; collisions refuse. Generic xai-grok observational hooks remain separate and may fail open. Every public adapter must appear in a mechanically checked route inventory.
children.falsifier: Bypass the shared ingress from any public face; forge tenant/role/account/root; reuse a key with changed principal/body; crash/timeout/misconfigure projection; or route mandatory policy through generic fail-open dispatch—zero spawn/effect is required. A route inventory, stimulus helper, standalone rustc test, or path-included module that no production composition root calls is a false green. Current Rust CLI/headless/ACP/MCP/plugin faces must invoke the choke; Gateway/webhook/cron adapters must export typed calls consumed by their later implementation nodes.

children.what: Implement Contract-owned public webhook lifecycle: create/list/inspect/rotate/pause/revoke endpoint and accept delivery through Gateway/CLI/MCP. Endpoint IDs are opaque and generations bind verified tenant, principal, provider schema, audience/route, allowed methods/content type/body limit, secret-handle generation, replay window and downstream Contract template. Verify the exact raw request bytes before parsing; adopt identical delivery only, refuse same delivery ID with changed digest. Persist no secret/raw body; pin verification evidence and request digest. ACK only after Contract durable intake or Cloudflare queue receipt.
children.falsifier: Reserialize before HMAC, use caller-selected endpoint ID, replay across tenant/endpoint/generation, parse oversized/wrong-content input, ACK before durability, retain raw body/secret, or let revoked endpoint declare work.

children.what: Replace runCell/control.json with a Smithers driver for Contract work. children.what: Expose Contract-owned pause/resume/cancel/revoke and semantic rollback through existing Smithers Gateway RPC, protocol/client, CLI and Aiko MCP—never direct DB APIs. Pause stops new claims and durably drains or parks in-flight work; resume preserves root/run and revalidates all pins; cancel is terminal. Tool/credential revoke is append-only generation CAS checked at claim and boundary. Semantic rollback creates a new Contract invalidation/compensation occurrence; Smithers rewind/time travel is only an operational fork and cannot erase settlement or resend crossed effects. Enforce tenant/owner and run:write.
children.falsifier: Direct DB mutation/read, claim after acknowledged pause, resume across drift, queued/boundary use after revoke, cross-tenant control, history deletion, or rewind/resend masquerading as rollback makes the public-only gate red.

children.what: Bind Contract and Smithers recovery: classify retryable/permanent/uncertain failures; persist next_eligible with capped deterministic backoff, attempt budget, per-tenant/root concurrency and queue bounds, fairness and explicit overload refusal. Exercise crash points before/after claim, Smithers journal, Cell spawn/result, Neuron outbox, provider acceptance/read-back and Contract settlement; reconciliation derives truth from Contract plus Neuron, never Smithers alone.
children.falsifier: Immediate/hot retry, unbounded queue, ACK-before-durability, blind uncertain-effect retry, poison-item blockage, tenant starvation, or any crash point producing false success/effect count >1 makes the gate red.
